props.name: hasToggle
props.description:
Has toggle?
- Dynamically enabled when the first slotted element is an ALPopover or ALMenu.
- **true** toggles the isSelected state on activation.
- **false** selects on activation; Escape or an outside click can deselect.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Indicates the selected state of the toggle button.

props.name: isSmall
props.description:
If true, a fixed width will be set on the button.
- Dynamically set based on the slotted component

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name for an icon-only toggle button. Visible slotted text supplies
the name when this property is omitted.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Variant
- **default** renders the toggle button without background styles
- **background** renders the toggle button with background styles

events.name: onToggleButtonDeselect
events.description: Fired when the button becomes deselected. Detail: `{ item, selected }`.

events.name: onToggleButtonSelect
events.description: Fired when the button becomes selected. Detail: `{ item, selected }`.

slots.description: The content to display in the toggle button

keyboard.action: Selects the button when it is not already selected.
Deselects the button when it is selected.
